hook: A resident says 'just pay it'. Switch itself stops the message: the agent never sees it.
opening: Housing society committees are unpaid volunteers who sign for crores. Registrars dissolve those who cannot show a recorded resolution. Society Room checks they had the right to pay.
b1: One template creates both rooms and four agents. Switch decides who may instruct each one.
b2: Even the Treasurer is refused: no passed resolution.
b3: The Chairman opens the meeting; the clerk counts quorum, 20 needed, 41 present, and records the vote by name. Only now does the treasurer book: invoice, resolution and bye-law check, all three.
b4: A Rs 4 lakh bid is over the bye-law 156 limit. Even a vote cannot approve it: it goes to the General Body agenda.
b5: In the General Body room a member asks why the society paid the lift contractor. The concierge answers only from the published ledger and minutes, and cites them.
closing: Switch decides who may instruct; the engine decides what is allowed. Same ledger the auditor signs.
